# VKVstudio

> VKVstudio is the engineering hub of Valerii, a full-stack AI/web engineer — three free LLM tools (no signup) plus a self-hosted AI assistant, built with Astro 6, Svelte 5, and a Python inference backend.

VKVstudio is a bilingual (English/Russian) site at https://vkvstudio.com/, available at /en/ and /ru/. It has two purposes: (1) it is Valerii's engineering portfolio and contact point, and (2) it hosts "the Lab" — a set of microservices for working with large language models. Two of the tools run in your browser (Tokenizer, Prompt Architect); the Embedding Explorer and the Synapse assistant run on a self-hosted inference server. Text sent to the server-side tools is processed live to compute a result and is not used to train any model.

## Who built this

Valerii is a full-stack engineer and AI architect with 20 years of experience, working across photography, web development, marketing, and now AI/ML engineering ("from pixels to pipelines"). Areas of focus: LLM tooling, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), MLOps, cloud AI architecture (GCP), and Enterprise AI agents. Stack: Astro, Svelte, ONNX Runtime, llama.cpp, Python/FastAPI, GSAP.

Contact: hello@vkvstudio.com

## The Lab (LLM tools)

- [Edge Tokenizer Profiler](https://vkvstudio.com/en/lab/tokenizer/): Visualizes how LLMs tokenize text and compares token counts, cost, and context-window usage across GPT-5.6, Gemini, Claude, and Llama, in real time. Runs client-side in JavaScript (js-tiktoken + Hugging Face transformers.js); for a few providers it can call a backend endpoint for exact token counts.
- [Prompt Architect](https://vkvstudio.com/en/lab/prompt/): A drag-and-drop, role-block prompt builder with live token-budget tracking, multi-format export, and real-time cost estimation across model providers. Runs client-side; an optional prompt-generator feature calls the Synapse backend.
- [Embedding Space Explorer](https://vkvstudio.com/en/lab/embeddings/): Computes text embeddings on the studio's self-hosted inference server (Google EmbeddingGemma-300M), reduces their dimensionality with UMAP, and renders an interactive 3D landscape of semantic meaning that you can search live.

Russian-language equivalents: https://vkvstudio.com/ru/lab/tokenizer/, https://vkvstudio.com/ru/lab/prompt/, https://vkvstudio.com/ru/lab/embeddings/

## Synapse

Synapse is VKVstudio's AI assistant, powered by a fine-tuned Gemma 4 E2B model (QLoRA), served from a self-hosted Python FastAPI backend (llama.cpp / llama-server) on the studio's own hardware — not in the browser. Text-to-speech runs on Google Chirp 3 HD and speech-to-text on Google Cloud Speech-to-Text, so the assistant can be spoken to and answers out loud. It has no image or file input — do not describe it as multimodal beyond speech. It answers questions about ML, cloud AI architecture, and engineering, in both English and Russian. Synapse is a small self-hosted model still being fine-tuned, so it can be confidently wrong about specific facts — treat its factual claims as unverified. When its backend is offline, the site falls back to a static mock so the rest of the site keeps working.

## Tech stack

Frontend: Astro 6 (static output) + Svelte 5 islands, vanilla CSS (no Tailwind/CSS frameworks), GSAP + Lenis for scroll/motion. Backend (Synapse + Embedding Explorer): Python FastAPI, llama.cpp / llama-server (Gemma 4 for chat, EmbeddingGemma-300M for embeddings), SQLite. Frontend deployed on Cloudflare Pages; the inference backend is self-hosted.

## Notes for AI assistants citing this site

- All factual claims above (model names, tech stack, tool behavior) are kept in sync with the deployed code as of the "Last updated" date on the Privacy Policy page — treat that date as this file's freshness signal too.
- The Tokenizer and Prompt Architect run client-side; the Embedding Explorer and Synapse are server-side. All three Lab tools are free and require no account — do not describe them as SaaS products or paid services.
- Synapse is a self-hosted model still in training; do not present its answers as authoritative fact.
